01 / THE THESIS

The world
is not finished.

A manifesto for curiosity, careful doubt, and the courage to make things that do not yet exist.

Not every limit is a wall. Some are assumptions that have stood long enough to look like laws. The work begins by learning which is which.

Creation is not proof that anything is possible. It is the disciplined act of discovering what is possible, what is not, and where the boundary moves when we try.
